# datadog_metric_historical_ingestion (Resource)

Enables Historical Metrics Ingestion for an existing metric. This resource does not submit or backfill metric data. The API enforces eligibility: supported custom metrics are count, rate, or gauge; distributions, metrics generated from other Datadog data types, and metrics with existing tag or aggregation configurations are incompatible. Reading requires the metrics_read permission and changes require late_metrics_config_write. Import reads an already-enabled metric without enabling it; removing this resource disables ingestion. Create and delete wait up to 60 seconds for visibility; a timeout does not mean the write failed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The metric must already exist and be eligible for Historical Metrics Ingestion.
resource "datadog_metric_historical_ingestion" "example" {
  metric_name = "example.application.requests"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metric_name` (String) Name of an existing eligible custom metric. Changing this value replaces the resource. Must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, periods, and underscores.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Server-provided creation timestamp in RFC3339 format, if available.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an already-enabled metric by its metric name.
terraform import datadog_metric_historical_ingestion.example example.application.requests
```
